subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an industrial corridor planned under the Government of India’s infrastructure initiatives?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata-Lucknow Industrial Corridor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Kolkata-Lucknow Industrial Corridor is **not an officially planned industrial corridor** under the Government of India’s infrastructure initiatives.
 
• Key industrial corridors currently planned include the **Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor (DMIC)**, **Chennai-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor (CBIC)**, and **Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC)**.
 
• The industrial corridors aim to enhance economic growth, create jobs, and strengthen infrastructure by connecting key cities and manufacturing hubs.
 
• The **DMIC project** is one of the largest infrastructure initiatives, spanning six states and focusing on high-tech industrial zones.
 
• Other planned corridors include the **Amritsar-Kolkata Industrial Corridor (AKIC)** and the **Bengaluru-Mumbai Industrial Corridor (BMIC)**, which are integral to India's economic strategy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor (DMIC)**

 
 
• A flagship project aimed at developing an industrial zone across six states in India.
 
• It spans approximately 1,500 km between Delhi and Mumbai, focusing on manufacturing and logistics.
 
• DMIC is expected to boost GDP growth and generate millions of jobs.
 
 
 
• **Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC)**
 
 
• Part of the East Coast Economic Corridor (ECEC), connecting Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.
 
• It aims to enhance manufacturing competitiveness and create economic opportunities along the eastern coastline.
 
 
 
• **Chennai-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor (CBIC)**
 
 
• Links Chennai and Bengaluru to facilitate industrial development, particularly in the automotive and electronics sectors.
 
• Focuses on creating high-quality infrastructure and promoting investments.
 
 
 
• **Industrial Corridor Concept**
 
 
• Industrial corridors are regions planned for economic development through industrialization and infrastructure connectivity.
 
• They aim to attract foreign direct investment (FDI) and promote domestic manufacturing under initiatives like "Make in India."
